summary: Free.ai grants 30,000 tokens/day after free signup (6,000/day if you stay anonymous). No credit card. Tokens reset every 24 hours; the daily free pool covers self-hosted models across the tool catalog, not every model in the 400+ tools. Premium/external model paths require a paid balance; token costs vary by model and tool. Free accounts allow 1 video every 2 days; a clip uses the whole 30,000-token daily pool on the day it is made. Other tools are limited by the token pool, not separate daily image, edit, or music caps. A free account unlocks the OpenAI-compatible developer API at api.free.ai, sharing the daily pool, with 1,000 requests/month and 60 requests/minute. The API docs How-it-works line says "Purchase tokens, then generate your key," but the same page's FAQ and rate table list a Free plan at 30K tokens/day and $0.
claim_steps: Sign up at free.ai/signup/ using the email/password form or Google or Microsoft sign-in; no credit card required.
Use the 30,000 daily tokens on the site, or open free.ai/api/ to generate an sk-free- API key.

Call https://api.free.ai via /v1/chat/ or tool endpoints. Self-hosted models use the shared daily free pool; premium/external paths require paid tokens. Stay within Free API limits of 1,000 requests/month and 60 requests/minute.

social_proof.title: Free AI Tools - Chat, Image, Video, Code | Free.ai
social_proof.text: Anonymous users get 6,000 tokens/day. Sign up free for 30,000 tokens/day and spend it however you like: about 300 chat messages, or 30 images, or a full day of music. Video is the one capped tool on free accounts, 1 clip every 2 days, because one clip costs more GPU time than everything else combined. A clip is 30,000 tokens, so it uses the whole daily pool on the day you make it.
